title: WordWave
description: A language-learning app built around short daily sessions: a unit-by-unit course, three exercise types, XP and streaks, and an SM-2 spaced-repetition schedule that resurfaces the words you keep missing. Ships with Spanish and Latin courses for English speakers — roughly 1,300 words and 4,600 exercises. A Travel Schooling class: learners sign in with their school account, and lessons and reviews earn XP on the shared school ledger.
